title: Fred S NDE 5312/3682/4850 NDE 4850
content:
5312 NDE was a result of surgery for a maxillary sinus uplift that preceded dental implants. The surgery consists of opening the gum line and exposing bone structure and grafting bone or a bone substitute. I had the same surgery on the left side ten years earlier under general anesthesia without complications. I have an abnormally low resting heart rate at 42-48 BPM and have been as low as 38 BPM. Anesthesia lowers the heart rate even further. I informed the anesthesiologist about my condition. The anesthesia was fed into my arm via an IV catheter. Shortly after the start of the procedure, I felt my legs go numb and then I couldn't move them. The paralysis crept up my body and into my chest, which constricted. The paralysis then proceeded up in to my neck and throat; I stopped breathing and started to panic. I tried to yell out but could not utter a word. I felt that I was being nailed inside a coffin. My body stiffened, I relaxed, and left my body. I could see myself outstretched and was floating above myself. Lucky, an alert dental technician saw my distress. The IV tubes were yanked out of my arm. I was resuscitated, came round and then passed out. The anesthesiologist met with my wife and verified that there was an incident that required resuscitation. After the incident, I became violently sick and remained that way for a couple of days. A feeling of detachment stayed with me for about 6 months. I felt as if I was in another dimension.

I was resuscitated back to a breathing state an | Yes Surgery-related. Allergic reaction 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I was having surgery and had a violent allergic reaction.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal As above. | Less consciousness and alertness than normal As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I really do not know. I was aware of my surroundings and myself during the detachment and floating above myself. | Before seeing my body go limp, I was very aware that I was on the edge of dying. After the limp body experience, I was aware of a panic stage in recovery. A week later, the anesthesiologist verified that the reaction and my condition was very real. | At the point of floating. I knew that I was dying.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Altered space as I left my body and floated above myself. | Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time seemed out of place somehow. | Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I was in an altered state to start. I could not judge time. Space was different as I seemed to be a part of it.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: The vision was from a different plane and quite clear. I could see myself and others from a different plane. | It was hazy, but then, I was going under anesthesia. I had enough depth and perception that I saw myself go limp. | My vision was slightly foggy but that could have been as a result of the anesthesia.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: No | Yes See above comments about two long dead friends. They told me that they were waiting for me and I felt that they were.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: No | Uncertain I did not see a sheer whiteness or bright lights. I thought that the scene seemed much brighter than normal.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I felt on another dimension as I left my body. I also felt on anotehr dimension for sdome time after the incident. | No | A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I felt another dimension or strange detachment and still do at times.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: At first terror as if being nailed inside a coffin alive. I was screaming inside of myself without making a sound. Then after a brief struggle with myself, I relaxed and left my body. | At first panic because I was aware of what was happening. Then, when I went limp, I felt myself giving up. For a brief moment when I started to go limp a calmness came over me. | Panic at first, like being nailed inside a coffin alive. I was clawing to get out but could not. I felt the paralysis and started screaming inside of myself as I could not scream verbally. I stiffened and my muscles became rigid. Then, as I started losing consciousness, I relaxed and felt I was floating. I felt more relaxed and I saw myself. I felt a calmness as I was floating away. But up until that moment I just felt sheer panic.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control | My past flashed before me, out of my control I now feel that dying is mostly in stages, if not instant, like a heart attack or auto accident. I am just learning to cope with the experience as it has been less than 10 days since the incident. I have had feelings of remorse, sadness and melancholy since the incident. I keep thinking about it and cannot shake off the thought that it is going to repeat itself. | My past flashed before me, out of my control It felt like I was on a different plane, like I experienced some void or detachment. I still feel this from time to time. Sometimes, I feel that the event was incomplete. For a while afterwards I did not care about surrounding things. I also feel that should this event occur again it will draw to an ultimate conclusion.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: No | Uncertain I am a liberal and have spiritual beliefs that I merge with scientific evidence. One would probably call that agnostic. As of late, I have been preparing myself, through adult confirmation classes, for confirmation into the church.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: No | Uncertain I am a liberal and have spiritual beliefs that I merge with scientific evidence. One would probably call that agnostic. As of late, I have been preparing myself, through adult confirmation classes, for confirmation into the church.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: No | Yes As described above, I felt on a different plane or in a different dimension after the event and still have some of that feeling.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes For a while after the experience I felt detached from relationships. I view life now as being too short and unpredictable to be pressured by certain people or events. My relationship with my wife changed for the better. My relationship with work has deteriorated due to increased pressure. As I think about the experience now, I feel it is time to improve my relationships. | Uncertain I feel different, which my wife commented on this evening. I told her that since the experience, I did not feel confident about my longevity and need to get things in order. | Yes The feeling of detachment seems to distance me in my relationships.

elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I became detached and seemed to be in another dimension for about 6 months after the incident. Things became clear. What seemed to be important before no longer mattered. I am able to ‘visualize’ and have sensitivities that I did not have before the event. | No | Yes I felt I was on a different plane, in a different dimension and felt detached for a long time afterwards. I really did not care about my surroundings; I had a feeling of ambivalence. I still have those feelings. I work with animals and since the event, I have noticed and feel that the animals have a special affinity to me. I can walk through our medical center and the animals waiting there gravitate to me. I sometimes feel like a St. Francis with the animals, but of course not that saintly.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The out of body experience and detached feelings afterwards. | Seeing my body going from paralysis to limp and being aware that it was happening. I felt myself giving up, surrendering. Upon revival, I was in a state of panic, gasping for air under an oxygen mask and grabbing everything around me. | Leaving my body and the subsequent feeling of being on a different plane or in a void.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Approximately one month afterwards. They reacted with curiosity about the out of body experience and how it made me feel. | Yes Within an hour of being revived I told my wife and her friend who drove me back home, a 2 hour trip. | Yes I have only shared the feeling of being on a different plane, a void and the feeling of detachment. People have noticed and remarked about the animals, but that may also be due to my nature in general.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: No | Yes I had a dream the evening prior to the incident about two long dead friends, husband and wife, 'were waiting for me'. It probably heightened my anxiety going into the procedure.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I felt that I was given a second chance. The reality is that life is fleeting and I realized the importance of living life to the very best, both personally and in relationships. Death is imminent and the experience I had was just a prelude. | Experience was definitely real I knew it happened and why and it was verifiable. I became exhausted. People told me days afterwards that I looked exhausted, tired and somewhere else. I remained in that state until two days ago (7-8 days). | Experience was definitely real I viewed the reality with a strange detachment. It was a unique experience.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I still live the incident as a reality and as if it happened yesterday. Mine was not a pleasant experience and perhaps that is because I was not ready to go. There is hardly a week that goes by when I do not think about it. | Experience was definitely real See above comments. It was medically verifiable. | Experience was definitely real It was real and the physiological response to the anesthesia was verified by the anesthesiologist and surgeon. I have done some research on the steps to death and feel that my experience replicates these other experiences as follows: 1) A life threatening event that shuts down body functioning. 2) An awareness of surroundings and the event taking place. 3) Panic, but being unable to do anything about it. 4) Paralysis and stiffening of muscle. 5) Relaxation. 6) Out of body with the ability to see oneself.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I heard voices but am uncertain if my hearing was any more acute or not. | There was no sound except from within me. I could hear myself screaming inside of myself. Sounds around me where more like whispers.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: This was real. I was at the stage of going limp and giving up. I constantly think about it. | I am going back to Mexico within a week of writing this. I do not have a comfortable feeling about the procedure. I have the feeling that I need to get things in order.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: A little more on the aftermath, of life after a NDE.
